mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units signals strong consumer demand, boosting economic growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals strong consumer demand and labor market tightness, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: strong demand and tight labor market
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS YoY > 5% and UNRATE < 5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 300,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) grows by more than 3% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% YoY, it signals robust supply-side and demand-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY > 3% and GDPC1 YoY > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
